larry-page.stakeMethod: 389,051,160 Class B shares beneficially owned by Larry Page / (6,659,444,154 Class A and Class B shares + 5,456,336,540 Class C shares outstanding on the April 6, 2026 record date) = 3.21%. Computed, not stated in the filing. Class B only: the proxy ownership table excludes non-voting Class C stock, so any Class C shares Page holds are not counted; if he holds any, his true economic share is higher than this figure. Neither filing discloses his Class C holdings.

mark-zuckerberg.stakeMethod: (639,347 Class A + 341,823,978 Class B beneficially owned) / (2,196,045,588 Class A + 342,377,716 Class B outstanding at April 1, 2026) = 342,463,325 / 2,538,423,304. Both classes have the same economic rights per share; computed from the proxy's class counts, not stated in the filing.

lee-jae-yong.stakeLabel: Samsung Life Insurance and its related parties stake

peter-thiel.stakeMethod: (68,871,556 Class A + 29,128,444 Class B + 335,000 Class F beneficially owned) / 2,397,157,109 shares of common stock (all classes) outstanding at the April 6, 2026 record date = 98,335,000 / 2,397,157,109. The 10-K states the three classes have identical dividend and liquidation rights. Computed, not stated in the filing.

brian-l-roberts.stakeMethod: (30,897,450 Class A beneficially owned + 9,444,375 Class B) / (3,564,377,095 Class A + 9,444,375 Class B outstanding at the April 8, 2026 record date) = 1.13%. Computed, not stated in the filing. Caveats: his holdings are as of January 23, 2026 while the share counts are as of April 8, 2026; his Class A figure includes 7,124,993 shares under options exercisable within 60 days and 563,317 shares under stock units vesting within 60 days, which are not in the outstanding count; and it includes shares owned by his spouse, a family charitable foundation and family trusts. Cross-check: proxy footnote 7 says that if he converted his Class B into Class A 'he would beneficially own approximately 1% of the Class A common stock.'

tobias-lutke.stakeMethod: (1,548,000 Class A + 77,750,132 Class B shares owned, controlled or directed) / (1,220,302,290 Class A + 78,073,584 Class B shares issued and outstanding at April 21, 2026) = 79,298,132 / 1,298,375,874. The single Founder Share is ignored. Computed, not stated in the filing.

stephen-a-schwarzman.stakeMethod: 231,924,793 Blackstone Holdings Partnership Units (February 20, 2026) / (748,688,068 shares of common stock outstanding + 445,586,312 participating Blackstone Holdings Partnership Units, both at December 31, 2025) = 19.42%. Computed, not stated in the filing. Basis: Blackstone Inc. common stock plus the partnership units of Blackstone Holdings held by its limited partners (Blackstone personnel and others), which are exchangeable for common stock one-for-one and share in distributions; together these are the whole economic interest in Blackstone Holdings. The FY2025 10-K gives no unit count at the Item 12 date, so the December 31, 2025 dividend-eligibility table is used; the 10-K's own 52.2% of class for his units implies about 444 million units, consistent with it. Adding the 34,494,942 unvested participating common shares to the denominator (total 1,228,769,322) would give about 18.9%.

phil-knight.stakeMethod: 35,815,174 shares (Philip Knight's Class B figure in the proxy, which by the proxy's convention counts his 27,479,487 Class A shares as converted into Class B, so it is his total of both classes) / (281,387,752 Class A + 1,202,110,951 Class B shares outstanding on July 8, 2026) = 35,815,174 / 1,483,498,703 = 2.41%. Computed, not stated in the filing. Excludes the 221,750,000 Class A shares owned by Swoosh, LLC (see family) and 521,792 Class A shares owned by his spouse, which he disclaims.

wang-chuanfu.stakeMethod: (1,540,871,550 A shares + 3,000,000 H shares) / 9,117,197,565 total issued shares at 31 December 2025. Computed, not stated as one figure: the report states the two holdings separately as 16.90% and 0.03% of total issued share capital. Excludes the 11,183,100 A shares held through the E Fund BYD No. 1 Assets Management Plan, which the report also leaves out of the 1,540,871,550.

lei-jun.stakeMethod: (4,063,148,182 Class A + 1,993,631,456 Class B shares in which Lei Jun is interested) / (4,511,553,144 Class A + 21,535,682,134 Class B shares in issue at 31 December 2025) = 6,056,779,638 / 26,047,235,278. Computed, not stated: the report gives his holdings only as % of each class (90.06% of Class A; 9.26% of Class B via Smart Mobile 8.54%, Smart Player 0.27% and Team Guide 0.44%).

n-r-narayana-murthy.stakeLabel: Infosys promoters and promoter group stake

brian-chesky.stakeMethod: (4,210,326 Class A + 62,492,000 Class B beneficially owned) / (418,897,799 Class A + 175,627,453 Class B outstanding at April 8, 2026) = 66,702,326 / 594,525,252. The 9,200,000 non-voting Class H shares are left out of the denominator because all are held by Airbnb's own wholly-owned subsidiary and the 10-K computes net income per share only for Class A and Class B; including them gives 11.05%. Computed, not stated in the filing.

michael-saylor.stakeMethod: (372,575 Class A + 19,616,680 Class B) / (400,856,753 Class A + 19,640,250 Class B outstanding at September 15, 2026) = 19,989,255 / 420,497,003. Common stock only; the perpetual preferred stock (STRF, STRC, STRE, STRK and STRD) is excluded. Computed, not stated in the filing. The proxy's own as-converted figure, 'Beneficial Ownership of Class A Stock (% of Class)', is 4.8%.

mike-cannon-brookes.stakeMethod: (275,940 Class A + 47,066,808 Class B shares) / (158,022,970 Class A + 94,133,617 Class B outstanding as of September 30, 2026) = 47,342,748 / 252,156,587 = 18.78%. Computed, not stated in the filing; both inputs are from the same table and date.

jack-dorsey.stakeMethod: (1,000,000 Class A + 47,844,566 Class B beneficially owned) / (535,370,474 Class A + 59,991,242 Class B outstanding at March 31, 2026) = 48,844,566 / 595,361,716. Class B converts one-for-one into Class A, and the 10-K says holders of both classes are entitled to dividends when declared by the board; the classes differ in votes (one versus ten). Dorsey's row contains no options or RSUs (footnote 4). Computed, not stated in the filing.

david-velez.stakeMethod: (3,088,117 Class A + 903,124,498 Class B beneficially owned) / (3,837,998,543 Class A + 1,022,600,698 Class B outstanding), all as of March 1, 2026 = 906,212,615 / 4,860,599,241. Computed, not stated in the filing. No options or RSUs are included in his row (footnote 2 lists only shares held of record).

david-baszucki.stakeMethod: (1,207,212 Class A beneficially owned − 20,664 Class A shares subject to RSUs vesting within 60 days + 47,070,464 Class B) / (662,895,615 Class A + 47,070,464 Class B outstanding at February 13, 2026) = 48,257,012 / 709,966,079. RSUs are excluded so the figure counts only shares outstanding (including them changes the result by less than 0.01 point). Computed, not stated in the filing.

vlad-tenev.stakeMethod: (6,907 Class A + 49,234,651 Class B shares beneficially owned by Vladimir Tenev) / (791,086,666 Class A + 109,745,620 Class B shares outstanding on April 8, 2026; zero Class C) = 5.47%. Computed, not stated in the filing. Beneficial ownership includes 565,079 Class B shares held by the Bhatt Family LLC that Tenev votes but in which, the proxy says, he has no economic interest.

eric-yuan.stakeMethod: (74,914 Class A issuable on RSU settlement + 20,837,285 Class B) / (265,368,026 Class A + 28,703,589 Class B outstanding at March 31, 2026 + his 74,914 RSU shares, which SEC rules deem outstanding for his own percentage) = 20,912,199 / 294,146,529. Computed, not stated in the filing.

ben-silbermann.stakeMethod: 36,911,603 Class B shares held by the Benjamin and Divya Silbermann Family Trust / (496,121,510 Class A + 79,679,925 Class B outstanding at the March 27, 2026 record date) = 36,911,603 / 575,801,435. His 8,414 Class A shares are RSUs vesting within 60 days, not outstanding shares, so they are excluded (including them changes the result by less than 0.01 point). Computed, not stated in the filing.

evan-spiegel.stakeMethod: (30,099,361 Class A + 5,862,410 Class B + 123,683,019 Class C shares beneficially owned by Evan Spiegel) / (1,457,403,389 Class A + 22,523,290 Class B + 231,626,943 Class C shares outstanding at December 31, 2025) = 159,644,790 / 1,711,553,622 = 9.33%. Computed, not stated in the filing.
